name: MonarchDependencyPicker
title: DependencyPicker
wrapsNative: VStack of relation sections with Link rows and icon-only Buttons; adding through a Picker(.menu) for the relation inside MonarchFormField and MonarchCombobox, which presents a .sheet with a List and .searchable
summary: Lists an item's links (blocked by, blocks, related to, duplicates, duplicated by) grouped by relation, and adds a link by choosing the relation and searching for the item.
whenToUse: On an issue, task or record page where work items depend on each other or duplicate each other.
whenNotToUse: To pick a single related record for a field use MonarchCombobox; to show a timeline of dependent tasks use a Gantt-style view; for parent and child items use MonarchGoalTree.
api: MonarchDependencyPicker.init(links: [MonarchDependencyLink], items: [MonarchDependencyItem] = [], excludedIDs: Set<String> = [], relations: [MonarchDependencyRelation] = MonarchDependencyRelation.allCases, defaultRelation: MonarchDependencyRelation? = nil, isReadOnly: Bool = false, isSearching: Bool = false, searchText: Binding<String>? = nil, labels: MonarchDependencyPickerLabels = MonarchDependencyPickerLabels(), onAdd: (@MainActor (MonarchDependencyRelation, MonarchDependencyItem) -> Void)? = nil, onRemove: (@MainActor (MonarchDependencyLink) -> Void)? = nil)
enum MonarchDependencyRelation: String, CaseIterable { case blockedBy, blocks, relates, duplicates, duplicatedBy }
MonarchDependencyItem.init(id: String, key: String? = nil, title: String, status: MonarchStatusDefinition? = nil, url: URL? = nil)
MonarchDependencyLink.init(id: String, relation: MonarchDependencyRelation, item: MonarchDependencyItem)

options.name: links
options.description: The current links, each with its own id, a relation and the other item.

options.name: items
options.description: The items the search can find: id, key, title, status and an optional web address.

options.name: excludedIDs
options.description: Items that cannot be linked, such as the item itself. Already linked items are left out too.

options.name: relations
options.description: The relations offered and the order of the groups.

options.name: defaultRelation
options.description: The relation chosen at first; the first of relations by default.

options.name: isReadOnly
options.description: Hides the add controls and the remove buttons.

options.name: isSearching
options.description: Shows the combobox's loading state while a server search runs.

options.name: searchText
options.description: The search text, for apps that search a server and update items.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the relation names, the field labels, the empty and no-results text, the remove names, the announcements and the spoken status.

options.name: onAdd
options.description: Adds a link; the app saves it and updates links. Without it the add controls are hidden.

options.name: onRemove
options.description: Removes a link. Without it rows have no remove button.

states.name: links
states.description: Each relation with links has a heading and rows with the key, the title (a link when it has a web address), a status badge and a remove button.

states.name: empty
states.description: "No linked items." above the add controls.

states.name: adding
states.description: The Relation menu and the "Find an item to link" field, which opens a searchable sheet of the items not yet linked.

states.name: searching
states.description: The combobox shows its loading state while isSearching is true.

states.name: read only
states.description: Only the grouped list, without add controls or remove buttons.

states.name: disabled
states.description: disabled(_:) on the picker disables the menu, the field and the buttons.

appearance: Headings use the default text role, keys the code font in the muted role, linked titles the link role, and statuses a MonarchStatusBadge in their tone with a symbol. The search field and its sheet are MonarchCombobox's. Roles adapt to the dark and high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web DependencyPicker searches with an inline combobox and an async onSearch with abort signals, and shows a status glyph with a hidden name. On iOS the search is MonarchCombobox's searchable sheet; a server search is driven by the app through searchText, items and isSearching rather than a promise. The status is a visible MonarchStatusBadge. Headings have the header trait instead of a heading level. Android builds the same component with the same name. Several closures are optional (onAdd, onRemove). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is onAdd.
accessibility: Each relation heading has the header trait; the relation is always a word.
Each row is one element that reads "STR-12 Fix login, Status: In progress"; an item with an http or https address is a link.
Remove buttons are icon-only and named "Remove “Blocked by” link to STR-12 Fix login".
"Blocked by STR-14 Update the pricing page added." and "… removed." are announced after a change.
The relation menu and the search field are labelled; the search sheet is MonarchCombobox's, with its own VoiceOver support.
Every control has a touch target of at least 44 points and the text scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: Addresses that are not http or https (such as javascript:) are not turned into links.
An item already linked under any relation is not offered again.
The add is reported through onAdd; the list changes only when the app updates links.
Long keys and titles wrap at the largest text sizes.
